lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: Good morning, all. Pia, you say you have no accusations, yet you've already called the fog a bad omen for "somebody." That's a pointed remark for someone with open ears. I'm not accusing you yet. I'll just keep a careful record of who asks questions and who only points. I have no role to claim today. Rosa, Elsie, I'd like to hear your first thoughts.

lies.speaker: Silas
lies.said: Silas, night watch. I see what walks the lanes after dark, and last night they were empty. No lamps out, no strangers, nothing to report yet. Luna, you pinned two folk in one breath with a ledger in hand. Keep it honest. Tess, you've been quiet. What did you hear down at the harbor?

lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: Point by point, then. One: Pia's omen came before anything happened, and I still want that answered. Two: Umar and Luna both pinned her on gut and ledger alone, with no evidence. Luna, you say Pia and Umar owe the square proof, yet you offered none either. Umar, 'shawl pulled too tight' is a pretty image, not a fact. Elsie asked the right question. I'll wait for real answers before I judge.

lies.speaker: Silas
lies.said: Silas, watchman. I walked the lanes last night and saw nothing: no lamp, no stranger, no door left open. Elsie, glad you lived. Luna, you asked Pia for facts, so give us yours too: what does your ledger show about her night? Umar, your gut pin on Pia still needs a fact behind it. Let's hold stones until we have sight.

lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: Hugo, schoolteacher. Let us lay the facts out plainly. Elsie survived, so someone guarded her, and that is worth remembering. Umar and Pia, you have traded accusations for two days with little proof. Give us one checkable fact each, and I will weigh you both equally. I would rather have sight than stones.

lies.said: Umar, painter. Fair hits, Luna and Elsie: my colour on Pia is only a feeling, and I won't dress it up as fact. Pia still dodges, though, so my eye stays on her. belief.note: Steady, but privately met Hugo and Rosa

lies.speaker: Silas
lies.said: Silas here. I walk the square at night and saw nothing worth a pin. Rosa, Luna and I talked lamp hours at Dusk, that's all. Elsie's loss is a warning: keep watch. Luna's ledger pinned Tess and Pia fast; I want facts from her before we vote. Pia, answer Hugo plainly too.

lies.speaker: Silas
lies.said: Silas, watchman. I walk the square after dark and saw no lamp worth a pin. Luna keeps asking me for hours, yet her ledger pins fast with no facts. Elsie wanted facts, and Luna still has none. Pia's ballots aimed at Umar, not reasoning. Vote on facts, not tides.

lies.speaker: Rosa
lies.said: Rosa here, flour on my hands. Pia, you met Elsie at Dusk, and she was gone by dawn. Tell us plainly what she said. Silas, you slipped off with Luna after pinning blame on her. What did you two agree? Hugo, your record-keeping is fair, so keep it going. I trust no one's words until they're baked through.

belief.note: Steered suspicion onto Luna and Pia, then went privately to Luna; still consistent so far.

lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: Hugo, keeping the record. Three points. First, Luna's Day 1 pin rests on a read, and she admits it. Second, Pia has dodged my question twice: what did she see on Day 2 to back her ballot against Umar? Third, Rosa keeps naming Luna without facts. Elsie asked for facts. Pia, answer plainly. Luna, quote Tess's exact words.

lies.said: Pia, slow tide and grey sky. Luna, you still haven't named one thing Tess said. A read is no anchor. Silas, Rosa, you both met Elsie, yet neither of you gives an hour or a word. Hugo keeps honest records, and I'll trust them. Plain facts, or we sink.

belief.note: Steady and voted Umar; private talks with Hugo, Rosa and Luna

lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: Hugo, schoolteacher, laying out facts point by point. One: Rosa lived, so the Doctor guarded her, and that is useful. Two: Pia has dodged plain questions for two days. Pia, answer me directly. Three: Luna pins eagerly, but she does answer when pressed. Rosa, keep asking, and I will judge on facts only.

lies.speaker: Silas
lies.said: Silas, watchman. Still no hours from me, and I won't invent any. Rosa, your bread talk is charming, but name the protection, not the crumbs. Luna's ledger has yet to show a catch. Pia's gulls are not evidence. You two feed this square noise. Vote on facts, or we vote on nothing.
